scope: Executed isolated native ROOT/TGeo geometry; both signs in both layouts, collar in 02. Envelope guards are not complete adjacent detectors.

LAYOUT-001.mass_ledger_scope: Common-constituent comparisons include sampling materials and structural aluminium only, matching the analytical partial ledger. Native component ledgers additionally include silicon pixels, coldplates and water-line walls/contents. Core line lengths reach the HCAL rear +50 mm; collar local lines end at the collar rear. External collar neck is tabulated separately. Air, envelope guards and omitted parts are excluded from mass totals.

guard_envelopes.scope: Circular annular guard using minimum apothem where polygonal; conservative for bore intrusion, not complete neighbouring geometry.

material_model: Named source densities and reference X0/nuclear lengths assigned explicitly; silica SiO2, buffer CH2 mass proxy, water H2O. Air has a negligible reference length for navigation. Device envelopes carry air; only 0.3 mm Si pixel slabs have sensor material.
included: Both matrix halves, exact finite long/short bores, nested buffer/silica
Sleeves, shells, closure caps, rear load ring and four cradle ribs
96 air cartridge/device footprint envelopes and 1536 silicon pixels per component/end
Rear coldplate and two straight OD6/ID4 water-equivalent coolant pipes per component/end
02 straight external collar-neck pipes at R294 after |z|4883
not_implemented: Individual optical fanout curves, ferrules and optical connectors
Collar radial collector, elbows and connection from collar R444 pipes to R294 neck
Dry-gas/electrical bundles, detailed front-end boards, device packages, outboard manifolds and external load frame
Full neighbouring calorimeters, downstream beam pipe/shielding and magnetic structures
DD4hep factories, sensitive detectors/readout identifiers, Geant4 transport, optical response, shower performance and engineering qualification
limitations: Native mass is partial and excludes omitted parts; direct comparison to the analytical partial ledger isolates common represented structural parts.
Sparse deterministic boundary rays validate navigation and finite-cylinder calculations; they do not establish efficiency, containment or hermeticity.
Reference material X0/nuclear lengths are assigned inputs, not independently calculated transport cross sections.
ROOT numerical overlap tolerance is not a mechanical assembly clearance.
